errors.description: The frame is not valid JSON.
The frame is JSON but not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 request (batches are not supported).
No handler is registered for the method.
The params do not match the method's schema.
An unexpected failure inside hx. Infrastructure failure, not a tool outcome.
The request was cancelled with $/cancelRequest before it changed anything.
Too many requests are queued; retry later.
A request frame exceeded the maximum size and was dropped.
At least one edit failed validation. Nothing was written. data.failures lists each failed edit with the closest match and its line numbers.
An edit targets a path outside the allowed globs. Checked before journaling. data.paths lists the paths.
An edit targets a protected path. Checked before journaling. data.paths lists the paths.
The workspace root cannot be opened as a directory.
The transaction exceeds a size or count limit.
A touched file changed between validation and write. Nothing was written.
Another transaction holds the workspace lock.
A write failed after the transaction started. The workspace was restored from the journal; data.restored is true.
No journal with that id exists in the journal directory.
The journal's manifest or data failed verification. Nothing was changed.
The journal is in use by a live transaction.
The journal is not in a state that allows this operation.
Restoring from the journal failed. The journal is kept; run txn.recover or retry txn.restore.
An unexpected I/O failure before any workspace write.
The platform cannot enforce a requested sandbox dimension and the policy did not allow degrading it. Nothing ran. data.dimension and data.reason say which.
The OS refused while the sandbox was being built or applied, so the command did not run. data.step names the setup step.
A long-lived sandboxed child could not be started (`sandbox.spawn` only; `sandbox.run` reports the same condition as the exit kind `spawn_failed`).
No running sandbox child has that handle: it never existed, or sandbox.wait already returned its exit.
Too many sandbox children are running at once; wait for or kill one.
